blind.description: A stylised medieval combat training dummy. It features an X-shaped cross timber wooden base resting flat on the ground supporting a vertical post, a rounded burlap/sackcloth torso stuffed with straw with tufts poking out, tied with ropes at the shoulder joints, a conical iron helmet on top, and a horizontal wooden crossbar acting as arms. A small round wooden shield with an iron rim and central boss is mounted to one arm. Surfaces are continuous, solid, and cleanly modelled in a hand-painted/stylised game asset style.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it displays the rounded top of the dark metal helmet at the centre, the horizontal wooden crossbar extending to the sides with a round shield on one side, and the four-armed cross-shaped wooden base extending outward beneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.2 to 4.5 feet tall (roughly three-quarters the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 feet wide across the arms and shield.
